Qin Shujian looked at Cheng An's captivating eyes and nodded his head gratefully. Cheng An rubbed her hair with satisfaction before leaning back on the chair and continuing to catch up on her sleep. Qin Shujian stared at the movie screen without blinking, raising his hand to touch his heart from time to time. She didn't notice what was going on in the second half of the movie. She didn't know what was going on, but from that moment on, her heart kept beating. It was like she was carrying a little rabbit. When she came out of the cinema, her little face was bright red from the little rabbit. Cheng An noticed that her cheeks had turned peachy pink, and touched her forehead with his hand, "Is it too hot?" Qin Shujian was embarrassed to say that her heart was beating all the time, so she could only nod along with his words. Cheng An stared at her for two seconds and said to her, "Wait." Then he walked to the dessert shop, bought two cones, and handed one of them to Qin Shujian. Qin Shujian had been fed a lot, and she was almost used to it. She subconsciously reached out to pick it up, but she heard Cheng An say, "Open your mouth." Qin Shujian didn't know why, and opened her mouth blankly. Then I was stuffed with a big mouthful of ice cream. She puffed out her cheeks and her eyes widened at the sudden cold entrance. Cheng An held the cone, looked at the ice cream on Qin Shujian's lips, and curled up the corners of his lips. Then he handed the cone into her hand. With one hand free, Cheng An placed his fingers on Qin Shujian's lips and rubbed them gently. Facing Qin Shujian's widened eyes, he said extremely calmly: "I saw your mouth was full of ice cream when you ate it. I'll help you wipe it." Qin Shujian raised his hand and rubbed the corners of his lips in confusion, thinking, did I eat it? It seems so. When Qin Shujian finished the cone in his hand, Cheng An handed her the cone that he had just taken a bite of and said, "I found out that I don't like sweet things. Please do me a favor and eat it." Qin Shujian didn't feel anything was wrong at all. She looked at Cheng An's ice cream cone that was almost melted. As she ate, she thought, why don't she like sweet things when it's so delicious? He's so picky. Cheng An watched the little girl next to him bite the ice cream he had bitten, and the corners of his lips curled up unconsciously. If she is willing to eat the same ice cream with him, she must like him. Just now in the cinema, when he said she was her man, she didn't object. Cheng An thought about the kiss just now, and the smile on his lips grew wider. Seeing that the time was almost up, he took Qin Shujian to the restaurant he had booked in advance. There were only two of them in the huge box. Cheng An didn't order too many dishes, but he specially ordered a bowl of longevity noodles for her. He also asked the waiter to pick up the cake he ordered early in the morning. I also opened two bottles of champagne, two bottles of red wine, and a few bottles of beer. A full table was set. He supported his chin with one hand, tapped the table with his fingers, and raised his evil eyes at Qin Shujian, "Xiao Jian, I'll give you a chance to say thank you." ps: Please vote for me~
